thread:
Nadia R.: Quick FYI — spotted inconsistent terminology across Console help: the Integrations page CTA says "Add connector", the help flyout title says "Integration settings" and docs site uses "connectors" and sometimes "integrations". Users in onboarding are pinging support.
Leo (PM): ugh. which is the canonical term we want? connectors or integrations?
Harper (Docs): Docs canonical is "connectors" (we centralized last quarter), but Console UI copy was never fully migrated. we should surface a single canonical term in the flyout and add a link to docs.
Riley (Frontend): implementation note: the help flyout title and the CTA label live in different code modules. unifying will require a small copy sync and a banner migration for older saved dashboards. low risk.
Omar (A11y): accessibility checklist: ensure that the help flyout title reads exactly the same for screen readers as the heading in the docs link target or include a hidden preface like "Docs: connectors" to avoid surprise. Also keyboard users expect the CTA wording to match the confirmation dialog — mismatch causes cognitive load.
Harper (Docs): proposed microcopy: CTA -> "Add connector" (Title Case), Flyout title -> "Connector docs", Flyout body -> "Connectors let you route data from services to Redwood models. See full docs for config examples." Link text -> "Read connector docs (opens in new tab)".
Nadia R.: +1 to Harper's wording. Please also add an inline sentence: "Previously called integrations in older flows" so support has context.
Riley (Frontend): ok i'll change the CTA and flyout title. i'll also add a redirect mapping so old URLs with /help/integrations route to /help/connectors. adding utm param: ?utm=console-help.
Leo (PM): acceptance criteria: 1) all Console CTAs and flyout titles use "connector(s)"; 2) help flyout includes canonical docs link with utm; 3) a short note about legacy 'integration' wording; 4) Omar signs off on aria changes.
Omar (A11y): will verify the aria-labelledby on the flyout, focus return, and that the link has descriptive text (no "more info").
help-bot: reminder set for #console-sync on Monday at 10:00 to confirm rollout :bell:
Harper (Docs): i'll open the microcopy PR and update docs to add a short "legacy term" blurb.
Nadia R.: thanks team — small touch but will reduce support churn. target: ship in next patch release. :rocket:
